parameters.text:
While waiting for the bus Billie and her friends Pete, Cece and Neo approach you and Stan. 
Billie acts friendly but that immediately turns into annoying jokes that make you uncomfortable. The smile on your face is erased and Stan recognizes it.
   
He seems to be unhappy that you have been ganged up on by Billie and the others. He gets in between you and them. 
You hear the conversation.
